items.prompt: When lift both distinct equal-depth nodes?

options.why: Equal jump targets could be the LCA or above it, so jumping both would discard the boundary being sought.
Different targets at equal depth remain in different branches below their LCA, so both jumps are safe.
The simultaneous-lift step follows depth alignment and the coincidence check; being root is not its trigger.
Labels have no ancestry ordering, so increasing labels cannot determine a safe jump.

items.explanation: Different targets stay strictly below LCA.
